basis: Customer profiles, saved delivery addresses, order records, optional uploaded images and support. Public search cache stores queries without a customer account key. iOS includes Firebase Analytics without advertising identifiers; its data is not linked to the GOStore account. Push tokens are linked to the account for app functionality. Website Google/Facebook tags are not embedded in the native app. Payment bank credentials are entered in the bank app, not collected by gostore.mn.

analytics.note: iOS Firebase Analytics: installation ID, session/device metadata and allowlisted screen names; no IDFA, IDFV, ads, user ID, search terms or order IDs. User can disable collection in Account.
